name: OpenSubtitles Provider
description: Official remote subtitle provider. Subscribes to subtitle.provider.query (search + download). With an api_key it uses the OpenSubtitles.com REST v1 API; without a key it falls back to the keyless legacy rest.opensubtitles.org search. Secrets live in plugin config only.

permissions.reason: Receive item title/year/IMDb id/season/episode/file name for subtitle search; return subtitle bytes for core to write as a sidecar.

configSchema.label: OpenSubtitles.com API Key
configSchema.helpText: Optional. When set, uses api.opensubtitles.com v1; otherwise keyless legacy rest.opensubtitles.org.
